comment: Dr. Lotfi is one of the few professors that treats his students as humans too. He is an incredible person, always willing to help outside and in class. The course is graded nearly solely on exams that are somewhat difficult without studying every inch of class content so be careful of that. He is quite good at explaining things though.
Dr. Lotfi is a good man. He cares about all students and gives good lectures.

Lotfi is a great professor who makes himself available any day of any week. While some concepts in this class can be quite difficult, he makes an effort to help students in and out of the class. Test make up 80% of your grade but the final can replace one of your two prior tests if you score better. The remainder is 5 easy HWs and 2 easy projects.
